story.heading: About
paragraphs: The official homepage names BG Electric Service LLC as local residential electricians for the Philadelphia area.
bgelectricservicellc.com did not scrape. This preview uses only electrician-philadelphia.net, which names the company and the inventory phone.

items: The leftover Unslop demo had no phone and no map. This preview puts both on the contact card.
Services listed include lighting, dimmers, outlets, ceiling fans, surge protection, and old-house rewiring.
Confirm emergency availability on the official site before you treat 24/7 as a promise.

feature.heading: Northeast Philadelphia neighborhoods on the official menu
feature.text: The official communities list includes Bustleton, Fox Chase, Northeast, Lexington Park, Oxford Circle, Pennsport, Somerton, Tacony, Torresdale, and Holmesburg.

spotlight.heading: Call the published mobile line
spotlight.text: Use 215-990-7966 from electrician-philadelphia.net. Do not substitute another electrician site or a leftover demo number.
